concerns.location: plan.md:2 – Rarefaction, CLR, BMI Imputation, VIF (Task T003)
concerns.text: The plan computes Variance Inflation Factors (VIF) on the CLR‑transformed genus matrix (Task T003). Because CLR transformation imposes a linear constraint (the transformed values sum to zero), the feature set is inherently collinear, making VIF undefined or artificially inflated. Using VIF to flag collinearity after CLR is methodologically invalid and will always flag many taxa as problematic.
